{{Recipe summary | Category = Cookie recipes | Difficulty = 2 }} {{recipe}} == Ingredients == * 4 large [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]] * 250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] desiccated [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]] * 200 g [[Cookbook:White Sugar|white sugar]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla Extract|vanilla extract]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] water (optional) == Procedure == # Preheat your [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 180°C. # Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. # If your paste is too thick to [[Cookbook:Piping|pipe]] with a large piping tip, then add the water, and keep adding one tablespoon of water at a time until you get a consistency you can pipe. If your eggs are extra large, you may not need the extra water. # Pipe dollops on a [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]]. # [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a medium to hot oven for 30 minutes or until done.
